properties.name: South of 51°N (Manitoba, British Columbia)
properties.source: Owner, Oct 11: no Chabad activity found in the far north of the provinces (searched Chabad sites, news and roving-rabbi reports), so north of a line just past the furthest activity is land in no shetach, like the Yukon and NWT north of 63°N. Only the province's own land is cut by it. Manitoba: only Winnipeg (49.9°N); the line keeps the Lake Winnipeg cottage country. British Columbia: furthest Whistler (50.1°N), Kelowna, families from Salmon Arm (50.7°N).
